from t import *
import ref, json, wire as W, hashlib

def check(name, tr, manual=None):
    got = run([tr])['traces'][0]
    exp = ref.audit(tr)
    ok = json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(exp, sort_keys=True)
    bad = [] if ok else ['REF-MISMATCH']
    if manual:
        for k, v in manual.items():
            gv = got
            for part in k.split('.'):
                gv = gv[int(part)] if isinstance(gv, list) else gv[part]
            if gv != v: bad.append(f"{k}={gv!r} want {v!r}")
    print(f"== {name}: {'OK' if not bad else 'PROBLEM ' + '; '.join(bad)}")
    return got

# ack adjacency merging across frames: frame1 [3,3]; frame2 [0,2]+[4,4]
def ackf(la, first, pairs, typ=2):
    out = bytes([typ]) + W.v(la) + W.v(0) + W.v(len(pairs)) + W.v(first)
    for g, r in pairs: out += W.v(g) + W.v(r)
    return out
a1 = ackf(3, 0, [])            # [3,3]
a2 = ackf(4, 0, [(0, 2)])      # [4,4] then gap0 range2: low=4 -> high=2 -> [0,2]
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, a1+a2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("ack-adjacent", tr, {'acknowledged.2.count':5, 'acknowledged.2.intervals':1,
                           'acknowledged.2.prefix':5})
print("   iv:", run([tr])['traces'][0]['acknowledged'][2])

# stream adjacency merging
f1 = stream(0, 0, b'abc', fin=False)
f2 = stream(0, 3, b'de', fin=False)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, f1+f2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("stream-adjacent", tr, {'streams.0.ranges':[[0,5]], 'streams.0.unique':5, 'streams.0.prefix':5})

# key set verification on a rich trace
tr = trace([dict(keys=['I','H','A']),
            datagram(envelope('A', 0, f1+bytes([0x18])+W.v(1)+W.v(0)+bytes([1])+b'\xdd'+b'\x11'*16, width=1), auth=[0]),
            datagram(envelope('I', 0, ackf(3,0,[])), auth=[0])])
g = check("keysets", tr)
TOP = {'packets','datagrams','closed','keys','received','key_epoch','epochs','opened','used',
       'send_max_data','send_max_streams','streams','crypto','acknowledged','peer_cids',
       'retire_prior_to','retired_local'}
assert set(g.keys()) == TOP, set(g.keys()) ^ TOP
assert set(g['packets'][0].keys()) == {'event','packet','offset','level','pn','epoch','status','sha256'}
assert set(g['datagrams'][0].keys()) == {'event','packets','accepted','bytes','sha256'}
assert set(g['streams'][0].keys()) == {'id','high','final','reset','stop','send_max','ranges','unique','prefix','sha256'}
assert set(g['crypto'][0].keys()) == {'level','ranges','unique','prefix','sha256'}
assert set(g['acknowledged'][0].keys()) == {'level','count','intervals','prefix','sha256','ecn'}
assert set(g['peer_cids'][0].keys()) == {'sequence','id','token'}
assert set(g['received'].keys()) == {'I','H','A'}
assert set(g['opened'].keys()) == {'bidi','uni'}
assert set(g['send_max_streams'].keys()) == {'bidi','uni'}
assert set(g['epochs'][0].keys()) == {'epoch','min','max','count'} if g['epochs'] else True
